item.title: LISTEN: County updates and year in review with Barnstable County Commission
item.description: 2025 has been a year of change for Cape Cod as it tackles affordable housing, failing water quality, and more. item.title: Falmouth Police investigate reported accidental shooting
item.description: FALMOUTH – Falmouth Police are investigating a reported accidental shooting in their town about 8:45 PM Thursday evening. Officials responded to a residence off Blacksmith Shop Road. The victim was transported to Falmouth Hospital with injuries that were not life-threatening. Further details were not immediately available. The post Falmouth Police investigate reported accidental shooting appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Head-on crash in Falmouth sends one person to hospital
